summary.text: Jim Marshall is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A software developer, he lists fully funding public education and lowering property taxes as his main goals.

paragraphs.text: Jim Marshall earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts, Lowell in 1990, and his career experience includes working as a software developer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Marshall said his main goal is to fully fund public education and lower property taxes, and he said the current administration has shifted costs onto towns.

He listed his key campaign messages as fully funding public education, lowering property taxes, and raising wages while supporting small businesses, and named education, tax policy, and the judiciary and law enforcement as policy areas of interest.
Marshall advanced from the Democratic primary for Rockingham 13 on September 8, 2026.
